subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Dante's Three Realms
description: A 60-second lesson on Dante's Three Realms.

hook.text: Dante walked through Hell, climbed Purgatory, and ascended to Paradise. He mapped the Christian afterlife.

buildup.text: Hell has nine circles, each for a specific sin. The deeper you go, the worse the punishment.

discovery.text: Dante placed traitors in the deepest circle—frozen in ice, not fire. The worst sin got the coldest punishment.

twist.text: The Divine Comedy was fiction, not scripture. Yet it shaped how millions imagine the afterlife even today.

climax.text: Dante gave Hell an architecture. His literary vision became more real than theology in the popular mind.

punchline.text: A poet drew hell, and everyone believed it.

quiz.question: What is at the very bottom of Dante's Hell?
